name: vertical-slice-data-contract
explain: Demonstrate Vertical Slice Architecture: validate end-to-end data contracts across frontend client payloads, API gateway validation and authorization, and asynchronous background worker execution.
steps: Construct typed frontend request envelope with client-generated correlation ID. || Validate Pydantic schema and tenant isolation in API gateway before dispatching to worker. || Verify that final durable database record matches the client correlation ID and tenant scope.
expect: Vertical slice contract verified: task_id starts with task_, client_id matches req_, status=completed

name: sse-streaming-reconnection
explain: Implement reactive Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming with Last-Event-ID reconnection reconciliation. Resumes token streaming after transient network drops without duplicate or missing tokens.
steps: Stream token chunks formatted with sequential W3C SSE event IDs. || Reconnect with Last-Event-ID header after a simulated network drop and replay subsequent tokens seamlessly.
expect: SSE reconnection reconciliation verified: full_text='The database transaction completed with success.', total_events=6

name: technical-review-artifacts
explain: Compile tangible engineering verification artifacts and evaluation telemetry for technical architecture reviews. Packages faithfulness metrics, latency percentiles, security regression suites, and token economics.
steps: Aggregate quantitative faithfulness, context precision, and latency percentiles into a review dossier. || Verify negative-path security suite results (zero cross-tenant leaks and 100% prompt injection blocking).
expect: Technical review dossier verified: faithfulness=0.942, p95=780ms, cost_per_query=$0.000388

name: non-ai-baseline-comparison
explain: Benchmark an AI RAG pipeline against a deterministic non-AI baseline (FTS + keyword rule matcher) to quantitatively justify return on investment (ROI), latency trade-offs, and architecture complexity.
steps: Measure accuracy, latency, and infrastructure cost across deterministic and AI implementations. || Calculate monthly net savings and annual ROI based on human support ticket deflection rates.
expect: Non-AI baseline ROI verified: baseline_cost=$66084.99999999999/mo, ai_cost=$25419.99999999999/mo, annual_roi=$487980.0

name: multi-tenant-cost-accounting
explain: Implement multi-tenant token cost accounting, dollar quotas, and atomic rate limit enforcement. Verifies tenant balance prior to execution and reconciles exact token spend with Decimal financial arithmetic.
steps: Authorize operations against tenant dollar balance and monthly quota limits. || Deduct exact model API token costs from tenant ledger, raising 429 Quota Exceeded when funds are exhausted.

name: distributed-tracing-correlation
explain: Implement W3C distributed tracing correlation across browser events, API gateways, message queues, and model APIs. Propagates traceparent headers to debug latency bottlenecks and duplicate execution races.
steps: Generate W3C traceparent header on client interaction and propagate through API gateway. || Correlate background Celery worker and model provider spans under the same global trace ID.
